source_text: Fili hominis, propone aenigma et dic parabolam ad domum Israel. Gloria Deo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Son of man, set forth a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel. Glory to God. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Son of man, propound a riddle and speak a parable to the house of Israel >> Bible:Ezekiel 17:2]]. Train the inner eye on the allegory. Glory to God. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
